in_marathi.name: Mritunjoy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mritunjoy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who conquers death, derived from the combination of ‘Mrityu’ (death) and ‘Njoy’ (conqueror). In Hindu mythology, Mritunjoy is a name given to gods and heroes who possess the power to overcome death.

In Hindu mythology, Mritunjoy is a name given to gods and heroes who possess the power to overcome death.
